source.title: Drillson Support Hover
source.author: RGriffin65
source.notes: Vehicle rework (LANCE-19 batch 2, 2026-10-30), differs from the mech text above: no joints or actuators. HOVER craft: no wheels or tracks. The fit is level and square (`no_icp`, yaw 90 in drillson_veh.json; the v1 fit's yaw 85 left it skewed). The kit's fused hull was split by `tools/art/v3/veh_prep.py` (drillson_prep.json) into the hull and the launcher turret (`TF_Turret`, turns about the vertical axis through its centre; the original's TF_Missilepods node has no part of its own, the kit has one launcher box). Needle triangles dropped; welded at 3 mm and planar-dissolved at 8 degrees, no collapse. The data gives the Drillson max_turret_yaw 0, so the turret only turns if the sim asks.
